senses.definition: an older word used to address two or more people; you

examples.en: Hear what I say, all ye people!
examples.vi: Hãy nghe những gì ta nói, hỡi muôn người!

wiktionary.gloss: You (the people being addressed).

senses.definition: used to express agreement; yes or yeah

examples.en: Are you coming tonight? — Ye, I'll be there.
examples.vi: Tối nay bạn đến chứ? — Ừ, tôi sẽ ở đó.

wiktionary.gloss: Yes, yeah.
The Cyrillic letter Е, е, featured in various Slavic and Turkic languages.

idioms.gloss: Something can be found if it is sought.
Used to express surprise or incredulity.
Pseudo-archaic form of the old, as to suggest antiquity or old tradition.
A response to an expression of doubt or uncertainty.
Lamenting a person or thing gone too soon.

tatoeba.en: Abandon hope, all ye who enter here.
tatoeba.vi: Hãy từ bỏ hy vọng, hỡi những người vào đây.
